feature_name: Bring Your Own IPv6 global unicast addresses for VPC internal subnet ranges
summary: VPC now allows assigning customer-owned IPv6 global unicast addresses to a subnet’s internal IPv6 address range as private range addresses.
extended_definition: VPC now allows assigning customer-owned IPv6 global unicast addresses to a subnet’s internal IPv6 address range as private range addresses.
